scenes.headline: How a 40B model decodes like a 2.5B one
scenes.sub: Recursive's Flint, and the arithmetic behind its laptop speed.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Pawl! Flint is Recursive's first model, a mixture of experts for coding on your own machine. Here is why it is fast.

scenes.text: On a laptop, decode speed is memory bandwidth divided by the bytes each token reads. Flint is designed to read fewer bytes.
scenes.say: The idea: every new token streams its weights through memory. So speed is bandwidth divided by bytes, and Flint is built to read fewer bytes.

steps.say: A token enters attention, which reads the cache earlier tokens left.
A router scores two hundred fifty six small experts and wakes only six. The rest are never loaded.
The output head turns that into the next token. Recursive stores even the head in four bits.
Each token touches two and a half billion parameters, out of almost forty billion.

steps.label: 35 sliding-window layers
steps.say: Thirty five layers only look back over a short window, so their cache stops growing.

steps.label: 14 full-attention layers
steps.say: Fourteen layers see the whole context, so their cache grows with every token.

scenes.title: The speed limit

parts.say: An M4 Pro moves two hundred seventy three gigabytes a second.
Flint's four bit weights cost about one and a half gigabytes per token, plus the cache.

scenes.say: Divide them and the ceiling is about one hundred eighty tokens a second.

scenes.title: Decode at 1K context, M4 Pro
scenes.note: tokens per second, as Recursive reports
scenes.say: Recursive reports about one hundred thirty one with its own engine. On another engine the same model is much slower, so part of the speed is the kernels.

scenes.label: what the rec engine holds from 1K to 252K context
scenes.say: Fit Recursive's whole curve to that formula and the engine holds about two hundred gigabytes a second at every context length.

scenes.text: Once the active body is small, the output head and the KV cache are what is left to shrink.
scenes.mark: output head and the KV cache
scenes.say: Once the active body is small, the output head and the cache are what is left to shrink. Flint shrinks both.
Six of two hundred fifty six experts, a four bit head, short windows. Speed is bandwidth over bytes.
